prompt:
This part belongs to the Vertical Cloud Lab "Powder Doser" — an auger-fed,
screw-metered dry-powder dispenser. Design it as a single, manifold,
FDM-printable solid (0.4 mm nozzle, ~0.2 mm layers; fin/wall features >= 2 mm).
All dimensions are in millimetres.

Shared fits & fasteners (apply where relevant):
- M3 clearance hole = 3.4 mm dia; M3 self-tap pilot = 2.7 mm; M3 setscrew pilot = 2.5 mm.
- M5 clearance hole = 5.4 mm dia.
- Auger / collar / bracket running fit over the 25.0 mm auger OD = bore 25.5 mm.
- Printed gears: module given per part, 20 deg pressure angle.

Archimedes auger — STORAGE variant, SHORT bench-test length (no gear band).

Outer tube: outer diameter 25.0, wall 2.0, bore inner diameter 21.0. Tube
length 90.0, axis vertical (Z). Top cap height 6.0 with 4 rectangular loading
slots (4.0 x 7.0) on a 6.5 mm radius bolt circle 90 deg apart plus a central
M3 pilot boss. Bottom funnel/cap height 12.0 tapering to a central exit hole
diameter 3.0.

Internal Archimedean screw occupies ONLY the bottom one-third (~30 mm); the
top two-thirds of the bore is open reservoir. Screw: central shaft diameter
8.0, single-start helical fin pitch 10.0 mm/turn, thickness 2.0, fin outer
edge reaching the inner wall. No external gear band on this bench-test part.

design_plan.description: Archimedes auger storage variant for powder doser - short bench-test length with outer tube, top cap with loading slots, bottom funnel, and internal single-start helical screw in lower third only

constraints.symmetry: 4-fold rotational symmetry for loading slots, axial symmetry for main body

design_plan.notes: Build from bottom to top: 1) Bottom funnel as truncated cone from OD 25 tapering to exit hole dia 3.0 over 12mm height, with central through-hole. 2) Main tube 90mm tall with OD 25, wall 2.0, bore 21.0. 3) Top cap 6mm thick solid disc with 4 rectangular slots (4x7mm) at 6.5mm radius, 90deg apart, plus central M3 pilot hole (2.7mm). 4) Internal helical screw only in bottom 30mm zone: central shaft dia 8.0 with single-start helix, pitch 10mm, fin thickness 2.0, fin extends from shaft radius 4.0 to bore radius 10.5. The helix makes 3 complete turns over 30mm. Upper 60mm of bore is open reservoir. Ensure helix is properly connected to shaft. Consider printing orientation - vertical axis recommended.

checks.message: All constraints met. The generated part correctly implements the Archimedes auger STORAGE variant: (1) Outer tube: 25mm OD confirmed by bounding box (25.0mm x 25.0mm), total height 108mm matches tube_length(90) + top_cap(6) + funnel(12). (2) Top cap: Visible in center view with 4 rectangular loading slots (4x7mm) at 90° intervals on the bolt circle, plus central M3 pilot hole (2.7mm). (3) Bottom funnel: Conical taper visible in isometric and front profile views, terminating at 3mm exit hole. (4) Internal helical screw: The helical fin is clearly visible in the high-angle rear view, showing the single-start Archimedean screw pattern occupying the bottom portion. Central shaft (8mm dia) with helical fin (pitch 10mm, 2mm thick) extending to bore wall is properly constructed. (5) Volume ~18,198 mm³ is physically plausible for hollow tube with internal screw mechanism. (6) No external gear band as specified for bench-test variant. All FDM printability constraints (>=2mm features) are satisfied.
